long_term_transaction_role.decision: Buyers and sellers arrange purchases and track order status within Terroir; sellers handle payment and fulfillment.
long_term_transaction_role.scope: Long-term product responsibility; launch scope remains undecided.

first_complete_job.user_answer: A then B then D then C in that order
first_complete_job.decision: Restaurant operations is the anchor workflow. Collector management follows, then producer/distributor supplier sales, then consumer discovery.
first_complete_job.scope: Product priority order; phase depth, exit criteria and launch commitments remain undecided.

restaurant_initial_segment.user_answer: I want to build it out to be ready for restaurant groups from day one: multiple venues, centralized purchasing, transfers and location-specific permissions.
restaurant_initial_segment.decision: Restaurant groups are day-one product scope, including multiple venues, centralized purchasing, transfers and location-specific permissions. Preserve simple daily staff workflows.
restaurant_initial_segment.scope: Supersedes single-location-first. Resolved through group_operating_structure, centralized_purchasing and within-business transfer decisions below; detailed permission and accounting contracts remain implementation proposals.

toast_launch_dependency.user_answer: Required for the complete release: A supervised pilot can begin with receiving and cellar management while we validate Toast mappings and deductions.
toast_launch_dependency.decision: Automatic Toast sales reconciliation is required for the complete restaurant release. A supervised receiving/cellar pilot may precede it while mappings and proposed deductions are validated.
toast_launch_dependency.scope: No assumption that Toast access is already granted or automated deductions are proven.

group_operating_structure.user_answer: B, with a simple setup for groups that only need A. Central oversight should not automatically pool inventory or expose every venue’s costs and supplier terms to everyone.
group_operating_structure.decision: Support a parent group with separate operating businesses and venues from day one, with a simple setup for a single operating business. Inventory, financial records, supplier terms and permissions remain separately scoped; cross-business visibility requires explicit authorization.
group_operating_structure.scope: Resolved: purchase on behalf of each named operating business at launch, same-business venue transfers only; central-owned redistribution is committed early expansion. No automatic group-wide costs/terms access.

central_purchasing_buyer.user_answer: A with the expectation to build out B very completely and quickly after launch. Plan for it now; defer implementation because it needs substantial testing, interviews and iteration based on real use feedback.
central_purchasing_buyer.selection: A at launch; B committed early expansion
central_purchasing_buyer.decision: Launch centralized purchasing on behalf of each operating business. Plan now for a complete centrally owned stock and cross-business distribution workflow as a prioritized early post-launch expansion. Use interviews, testing and pilot feedback to validate that expansion.
central_purchasing_buyer.scope: B is committed direction, not an optional someday feature. No fixed date or untested accounting/ownership policy is inferred. Model ownership, custody and ordering responsibilities explicitly without promising no future migrations.

launch_transfer_scope.user_answer: A — Within one operating business: Move wine between that business’s venues.
launch_transfer_scope.decision: Launch stock transfers are limited to venues within the same operating business. Cross-business transfers for service are not a launch commitment.
launch_transfer_scope.scope: This does not alter day-one multi-business group structure or the committed early centrally owned stock expansion. No timing for cross-business service transfers is inferred.

transfer_authorization.selection: B at launch; allow future C
transfer_authorization.user_answer: B. Keep routine transfers straightforward and accountable, but leave the door open to grow into C.
transfer_authorization.decision: Delegate launch transfers to designated venue managers within their permissions, with dispatch, receipt and audit records. Preserve a path to business-defined conditional approval rules later.
transfer_authorization.scope: No conditional approval engine, thresholds or delivery date approved for launch. Parent-group role does not automatically grant business-level access.

wine_inventory_authority.user_answer: A. One clear inventory record for receiving, cellar and transfers, with calculated stock checked against physical counts and imports/exports supporting migration.
wine_inventory_authority.decision: Terroir is the primary operational record for wine stock quantities and movements. Toast supplies sales events; physical counts remain observations used for reconciliation; financial accounting remains in its existing system. Support imports/exports for migration.
wine_inventory_authority.scope: No automatic Toast menu/availability write-back, general-ledger replacement, unnamed vendor two-way synchronization or expansion beyond wine is inferred.

first_market.selection: A — one country with focused pilot region
first_market.user_answer: Agrees with focused pilot geography while retaining multi-venue and separate-business capabilities. Adds global wine search and learning for any user, covering region, wine and producer.
first_market.decision: Concentrate initial restaurant interviews and operational validation in one country and a focused region. The specific country and region remain unanswered.
first_market.scope: Does not geographically limit global wine discovery and education. No country inferred.

first_market_location.user_answer: The first country should be USA and then Europe.
first_market_location.decision: United States is the first restaurant operational market. European expansion follows.
first_market_location.scope: Europe is an expansion region; specific countries and their order remain undecided. Initial US pilot region remains undecided. Global wine discovery is not restricted to operational markets.

us_pilot_region.user_answer: Yes the city is Los Angeles.
us_pilot_region.decision: Los Angeles is the initial restaurant-group pilot location in the United States.
us_pilot_region.scope: No named or committed pilot group, provider entitlement or validated regional operating rules inferred. USA first and European expansion next remain accepted; global discovery remains separate.

global_discovery_access.user_answer: A. Someone looking up a bottle can immediately explore its producer and region. Public content uses information we have permission to publish; private cellar and business records remain protected.
global_discovery_access.decision: Allow signed-out public wine search and reading of publishable wine, producer and region knowledge. Private cellar/business records remain access-controlled.
global_discovery_access.scope: Does not approve anonymous uploads/AI scans, unlimited search, public personal notes, checkout, or a launch date. Rights and source coverage must be verified.

global_discovery_interface.user_answer: C as the product direction. Interactive geographic discovery, with map-data and interaction work to validate; timing separately; search remains available alongside map.
global_discovery_interface.decision: Provide region-page geographic context and an interactive map for exploring regions, producers and wines by place, alongside searchable linked pages.
global_discovery_interface.scope: Product direction approved; launch timing, verified geographic coverage, granularity, source rights and map implementation remain to define. No private cellar locations become public.

global_discovery_release_timing.user_answer: B — The full experience: Search, knowledge pages and the interactive map are all required.
global_discovery_release_timing.decision: The first complete restaurant release must include public global wine search, useful wine/producer/region knowledge pages, region context maps and interactive geographic exploration, alongside the complete restaurant scope and Toast reconciliation.
global_discovery_release_timing.scope: Supersedes recommendations to defer the interactive map. Earlier supervised pilot is still permitted. No release date, exhaustive worldwide data coverage, source access or named provider rights inferred.

knowledge_publication_authority.user_answer: A for launch. Editorial approval with source quality/contributor verification, planned reviewer capacity and correction turnaround, attributed producer contributions that do not automatically override independent ratings or regional facts.
knowledge_publication_authority.decision: External human contributor changes require Terroir editor approval before public publication at launch. Preserve attribution and independent-source authority; plan reviewer responsibility and turnaround.
knowledge_publication_authority.scope: No editor staffing or response-time SLA established. AI editorial authority and automated trusted-source imports remain unresolved. No producer direct-publication scope approved for launch.
knowledge_publication_authority.clarification_from_q15: Terroir editorial review may be automated for routine prose under defined source/evidence rules; human reviewers handle exceptions. Contributor review-before-publication remains required.

ai_public_knowledge_publication.user_answer: B — Controlled automated publication. Routine content can publish under defined source-and-evidence rules. Exceptions require human review, with ongoing sampling and rollback.
ai_public_knowledge_publication.decision: Allow routine standing public explanatory content to publish through controlled automated editorial review at launch. Defined exceptions require human review, with ongoing sampling and rollback. Applies to the publication-authority question covering both AI drafts and contributor drafts.
ai_public_knowledge_publication.scope: Human approval of every prose item is not required. Does not permit raw unreviewed contributor publishing, arbitrary AI confidence gates, or automatic changes to private operational records. Source/evidence rules, exception classes, ownership, review capacity and sampling/rollback procedures must be specified and validated.

collector_primary_outcome.user_answer: Everyday collecting first, centered on managing and enjoying wine. Account for deeper documentation in the design; its full workflow remains a deliberate scope decision.
collector_primary_outcome.decision: Prioritize everyday collecting in the collector phase: holdings, locations, drinking choices, tasting memory and purchase planning, retaining acquisition costs and receipts. Consider deeper provenance/condition/custody documentation in design without making the complete advanced workflow a collector-release requirement.
collector_primary_outcome.scope: No commitment to valuation feeds, investment/insurance capabilities, mandatory per-bottle tracking, or a date for advanced documentation. Collector phase remains after restaurant phase.

personal_business_identity.decision: One lasting Terroir identity with separated personal and business contexts and scoped memberships. Leaving a business revokes its work access while personal cellar continuity remains.
personal_business_identity.scope: Business admins receive no automatic personal-data access. Work-note portability, exact identity-provider/recovery rules and employer-managed login compatibility remain separate.

collector_collaboration.decision: Personal cellars are private by default. Owners may invite chosen people with scoped viewing or management access.
collector_collaboration.scope: No automatic public sharing, stock ownership transfer, blanket cost/receipt visibility or unrestricted export/delete permission inferred. Exact permission defaults require specification.

supplier_primary_workflow.decision: The first supplier phase prioritizes selling to restaurants: account-specific availability, quotes and order coordination linked to restaurant purchasing/receiving.
supplier_primary_workflow.scope: Workflow priority rather than company-type exclusion; producers/importers/distributors may participate where applicable. No supplier ERP, forced price disclosure, trading entitlement or validated adoption inferred.

work_note_portability.decision: Work notes remain in their business context by default. Add a business-controlled mechanism to permit personal copies of selected tasting notes, excluding confidential business information and recording the grant.
work_note_portability.scope: No automatic author entitlement, unrestricted export, retrospective access after membership removal or legal/IP ownership claim. Grant roles, allowed fields, revocation/copy semantics and audit must be specified.

ai_wine_guide_scope.decision: Add an optional conversational advisory guide for explanations, comparisons and recommendations using public knowledge and preference/cellar information the user explicitly makes available under their permissions. Show sources and uncertainty; it cannot purchase, publish or change inventory.
ai_wine_guide_scope.scope: Timing/access resolved by ai_guide_release_timing and ai_guide_access: required at collector release; anonymous general guidance plus explicit authorized private context. No real-time availability, medical safety or investment authority implied.

consumer_purchase_coverage.decision: For the consumer buying phase, support mixed seller coverage: connected sellers offer in-app coordination; other permitted listings clearly link out to the seller. Distinguish external orders Terroir cannot manage or observe.
consumer_purchase_coverage.scope: Both physical and online sellers remain in scope. Source rights, exact product matching, freshness and actual connection capabilities need verification. Does not introduce Terroir checkout/payment/fulfillment or move consumer commerce into restaurant launch.

ai_guide_release_timing.decision: The advisory wine guide is required for the first complete collector release. Public search, knowledge pages and interactive map remain required for the preceding complete restaurant release.
ai_guide_release_timing.scope: No calendar date, extra action authority or automatic expansion of the supervised pilot inferred.

ai_guide_access.decision: Signed-out visitors can ask general wine-knowledge questions under usage controls. Signed-in users may explicitly enable authorized personal or selected business context.
ai_guide_access.scope: Login alone does not grant or activate private retrieval. Pricing/quotas/providers remain to specify; guide remains advisory and cannot execute purchases, publishing or inventory edits.

community_primary_value.selection: A initially, with additional social-profile requirement
community_primary_value.user_answer: Private tasting groups initially; also wants individuals including wine reviewers, sommeliers and producers to follow profiles, post and interact.
community_primary_value.decision: Begin community with private invited tasting groups and explicit sharing. Include individual profiles, following, posting and interaction as an explicit product capability for enthusiasts and wine professionals.
community_primary_value.scope: Visibility/timing resolved: opt-in public profiles and posts after initial private groups as committed expansion. No automatic private/work publication or professional affiliation verification inferred.

social_profile_visibility.decision: Users may opt into public individual profiles and choose public posts/interactions alongside private groups. Private cellar and work records are never published automatically.
social_profile_visibility.scope: Public professional affiliation, producer representation and badges require distinct verification. No compulsory public profile, automatic work-note sharing or universal public visibility inferred.

social_profile_timing.decision: Ship private invited groups first, then richer profiles, following and posting as a committed community expansion. Basic group-member identity exists in the initial group experience.
social_profile_timing.scope: No calendar date or restaurant-launch community requirement inferred. Expanded social layer remains required direction, not optional someday.

revenue_model.decision: Subscriptions are Terroir’s primary revenue model.
revenue_model.scope: Exact payer tiers, prices, free/paid feature packaging, billing units and secondary revenue streams remain to validate/specify. This does not automatically settle ranking or advertising policy.

ranking_commercial_influence.decision: Permit clearly labeled sponsorship in separate areas. Payment must not alter organic rankings, ratings or advisory-guide recommendations.
ranking_commercial_influence.scope: Permitted policy, not a requirement to implement ads at launch. Subscriptions remain primary. No paid targeting/tracking contract, factual endorsement, verification outcome or sponsorship supplier inferred.

toast_writeback_scope.decision: First complete restaurant release reads Toast data for reconciliation; staff update Toast availability themselves. Evaluate outbound availability updates afterward.
toast_writeback_scope.scope: Live inbound integration remains required target, not currently implemented. No first-release outbound writes, arbitrary menu/price editing, actual write entitlement or fixed later delivery date inferred.

offline_critical_workflows.decision: Support cached viewing and offline capture of photos, tasting notes and physical count observations as visibly pending drafts, validated/reconciled on reconnection.
offline_critical_workflows.scope: No full offline consumption/receiving/transfers, offline AI requirement, native-app commitment, silent stock overwrite or guarantee of synchronization before reconnection. Local-data protection and permission recheck required.

knowledge_coverage_acceptance.decision: Public search may show identified wines with explicit background-information gaps. Publish richer knowledge only where supported by permitted sources; useful knowledge pages and the interactive map remain release requirements.
knowledge_coverage_acceptance.scope: No invented narratives, implied vineyard precision, universal coverage guarantee or permission to replace all useful pages with empty stubs. Coverage and source quality need measured acceptance.
